params.message:
Bespreken first in the Overdracht menu, and where handover users land

Bespreken is where the handover work is done; Netwerk and Historiek are
for looking things up. The Overdracht group now reads Bespreken,
Netwerk, Historiek, Medewerkers, and a shared link or a login without
office rights opens Bespreken instead of Historiek.
